lineup:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art RPG character sprite sheet for Wyrdholt. Create genuinely beautiful premium hand-crafted-looking pixel sprites, not flat code-drawn blocks.
Reference image role: the attached official Sea of Stars sprite is a STYLE reference for controlled pixel clusters, hue-shifted shadows, readable face, contour definition and sculpted cloth. Create entirely original designs, do not reproduce that character.
Output composition: transparent 1024x1024 sheet, EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows. Each cell is 256x512. No text, borders, labels, ground shadows, backdrop, scenery or extra objects. Each character centered horizontally in its cell, feet at 480 pixels down within that cell, top of hair at about 64 pixels down. Keep all pixels inside its cell with at least 16px clear margin. All figures face three-quarter RIGHT, full body visible. Consistent scale: each figure is approximately 96-104 NATIVE pixels tall, enlarged exactly 4x nearest-neighbor for delivery. Every native pixel is a clean 4x4 square, no smaller speckles, blurry edges or smooth vector curves.
Art direction: expressive high-end fantasy pixel-art like the craft of Sea of Stars and the mature proportions of Children of Morta. Elegant 5.5-to-6-head proportions, distinct expressive faces, attractive silhouettes, hands with readable grip shapes, clear wrists, believable feet, muscular forms made from nuanced contours. Sculpted fabric folds and subtle material wear. Selective dark plum outlines, warm ivory highlights, teal/lavender shadows; 5-6 carefully stepped shades per material, deliberate pixel clusters, minimal dithering. Rich but restrained jewel accents. No muddy brown-on-brown camouflage. No chunky square heads, stick limbs, robotic poses, voxel look, outline-only anatomy or painterly anti-aliasing.
Columns left to right:
1 MONK: athletic dark-skinned adult man, shaved head, amber scarf and cream asymmetric sleeveless wrap tunic, deep indigo loose trousers, rust waist sash; poised open-handed martial stance with wrists in front of chest, both feet visible.
2 WARRIOR: broad-shouldered adult man, brown swept hair and neat short beard, strong readable face, desaturated slate quilted sleeveless vest, off-white undershirt, navy trousers, leather waist belt; sturdy balanced stance, arms relaxed slightly away from body, near hand palm closed ready to grip.
3 MAGE: tall elegant older man, silver swept-back shoulder-length hair and short flowing white beard, plum-violet ankle-length simple robe with pale linen neckline and narrow copper sash; upright graceful stance, near hand raised at waist ready to grip a staff.
4 RANGER: athletic auburn-haired adult woman, long tied-back hair, woodland teal fitted sleeveless tunic, cream sleeves, dark blue trousers, russet leather belt and scarf; confident light stance, near hand raised at waist ready to grip a bow.
TOP ROW: Starting clothes as described, BARE HEADS, bare hands, bare feet, NO weapons, hats, armour, gloves, boots, rings, jewelry, bags or quivers. Do not draw any weapon or gear that would remain baked into the character.
BOTTOM ROW: The EXACT SAME four people in the exact SAME positions and poses, but with authored detailed equipment:
Monk woven saffron-and-ivory ceremonial chest wrap with dark jade trim, bronze brow band, indigo wrist wraps, leather-strapped sandals, compact pearl-and-bronze fist wraps.
Warrior sculpted worn steel breastplate over dark navy cloth, brass-edged shoulder piece, open-faced watch helmet that keeps face visible, detailed oxblood gauntlets and tall steel-toe leather boots, narrow steel sword gripped firmly in near hand.
Mage elaborate midnight-purple embroidered robe, small silver circlet, pale lavender gloves, soft leather boots and willow-branch staff topped with a clearly shaped amber crystal, staff crossing the palm.
Ranger fitted moss-green leaf-panel coat with russet shoulder cape, feathered hood leaving face visible, fine leather archery bracer, laced dark boots, curved yew bow held exactly through its centre grip.
Emphasize the beauty and precision of the faces, hands, fabric and equipment. This sheet must immediately look like professional pixel-game assets when reduced 4x. Preserve real alpha transparency.
poses:
Edit target: the supplied original Wyrdholt pixel-character lineup.
Create a production animation sprite sheet with the SAME four original people and the SAME finely detailed pixel-art style. The TOP ROW of four starting-clothes characters is the identity and costume reference. Preserve their expressive faces, hair, anatomy, and nuanced pixel-cluster shading. Pixel art ONLY: sharp deliberate stepped edges and clustered color ramps, no smooth painting or blurred anti-aliasing.
Replace the bottom row of armoured characters with attack poses of those TOP ROW STARTING-CLOTHES characters. Exactly four columns, two rows. Top row four idle poses; bottom row four attack poses. Preserve same order Monk, Warrior, Mage, Ranger. TOP ROW: same starting clothes, bare hands, bare heads, bare feet, no equipment. BOTTOM ROW: exactly the same starting clothes and bare hands/feet/head. Absolutely NO weapons, armor, hats, gloves, boots, jewelry, effects, streaks, sparks or text anywhere. Neutral transparent background.
The four columns must remain evenly spaced with each character isolated inside its own quarter. Keep the same feet baseline, head height and hip horizontal centre for each character between idle and attack. Show full bodies, no cropping. Make enough transparent room on the RIGHT for attacking arms. In each row, keep at least 24px clear margin around every character.
ATTACK POSES, facing three-quarter RIGHT:
MONK: confident authentic martial-arts straight punch toward the right, near arm fully extended horizontally at chest height, anatomically natural shoulder, upper arm and forearm. Other hand in guard. Torso only slightly turned, feet planted and knees softly flexed. Cream asymmetric wrap tunic, amber scarf, indigo trousers and rust sash unchanged.
WARRIOR: strong forward striking pose, near arm extended to the right at lower-chest height, closed fist with thumb folded as if gripping a sword HANDLE, but draw NO sword or handle. Other hand guards at left waist. Broad shoulders, navy quilted sleeveless vest, cream rolled sleeves and navy trousers unchanged. Feet planted, body weight clearly forward.
MAGE: elegant forward casting/striking stance, near forearm extended to the right at chest height, fingers closed around an INVISIBLE vertical staff, draw NO staff or magic. Other hand slightly raised at waist. Purple robe, pale neckline and copper sash unchanged. White hair and beard flowing subtly, not exaggerated. Both feet visible.
RANGER: natural archer release stance holding an INVISIBLE bow, bow arm extended to the right at shoulder/chest height, other hand at cheek/shoulder drawing an invisible string. Draw NO bow, string or arrow. Teal fitted sleeveless tunic, cream sleeves, indigo trousers, rust scarf and auburn ponytail unchanged. Feet planted.
The heads and torsos must remain beautifully drawn, NOT horizontally stretched. Use the same mature expressive proportions as the reference. This is a crisp detailed pixel-art animation asset, with no smooth-paint treatment, no black shadow blobs, and real alpha transparency.

gear.monk:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art EQUIPMENT ATLAS for the MONK in the supplied Wyrdholt character reference. Reference image is STYLE/PALETTE/PROPORTIONS only. Draw ORIGINAL separate wearable items with the same beautiful detailed pixel workmanship: selective plum outlines, warm highlights, cool colored shadows, deliberately shaped pixel clusters, finely described metal, leather and fabric. Crisp sophisticated RPG pixel art. Not photographs, not smooth vector icons, not muddy flat blocks.
Transparent square atlas. EXACTLY 8 columns and 4 rows, 32 equal square cells. ONE isolated item centered inside each cell. Keep at least 12% transparent padding on all four sides of every cell; nothing may cross cells. No cell outlines, labels, text, icons, ground shadows or background. Every cell occupied with exactly the item in the specification. Uniform item art scale within each equipment category.
Wearable parts only: NO PEOPLE, faces, hair, mannequins, bodies or hands inside clothing. Hoods have an empty transparent face opening; clothing has an empty transparent neck opening. CHEST items are single front/three-quarter-RIGHT garment torsos, no arms, sleeves extend only into short shoulder caps, the hips and garment hem can be visible. Monk and Ranger fitted pieces; Warrior broad armour; Mage long slim robes. Gloves and boots are SINGLE pieces, three-quarter RIGHT. All boots point RIGHT. Glove wrist at top, fingers down. Rings are standalone jewelry, not worn. Monk fist wraps are single closed wrapped fists. Swords point vertically UP with grip at bottom center. Staffs vertical UP with continuous shaft. Bows curve to the RIGHT with a precisely identifiable centre grip and taut string connecting the tips. Every item physically contiguous and complete, no detached sparkles, floating gems, decorative effects or shadows.
Every named item needs its own construction, silhouette, seams and ornaments, never just the same shape recolored. Clear inventory-icon readability but enough detail for wearable overlays. Each icon should use about 50-80 native pixels across, shown enlarged with nearest-neighbor crisp pixel edges and deliberate limited color ramps.
Read cells LEFT TO RIGHT in each row:
ROW 1: Wayfarer Wraps: single cream and rust fist wrap on a CLOSED fist; Reedweave Wraps: single woven jade reed knuckle wrap on CLOSED fist; Iron Palm Wraps: single steel blue reinforced knuckle guard on CLOSED fist; Thunder Palm Wraps: single indigo gold lightning embroidered fist wrap on CLOSED fist; Stillwater Fists: single pale jade bronze crescent fist guard on CLOSED fist; Copper Band: simple hammered copper ring; Amber Ring: bronze prayer ring with amber bead; Ember Seal: broad square bronze flame signet.
ROW 2: Linen Hood: ivory and rust cloth forehead headband with short ties; Scout Hood: olive knotted browband with longer cloth tails; Seer's Circlet: bronze and jade circlet with lavender stone; Crown of Thorns: woven copper thorn forehead band; Cinder Crown: low gold flame-point circlet; Moonlit Loop: silver crescent engraved meditation ring; Oath of Embers: ornate bronze ring with flame-shaped jade setting; Courtyard Sandals: single brown leather sole sandal with crossed ivory straps.
ROW 3: Trail Tunic: ivory asymmetric sleeveless cross-body wrap vest with rust sash; Rootwoven Coat: sleeveless layered jade-and-cream wrap vest; Ironbark Mantle: sleeveless dark blue reinforced lamellar wrap vest; Cinderweave: sleeveless rust and indigo ceremonial wrap vest with flame border; Last Light Vest: sleeveless ivory-and-gold elegant asymmetric long sash vest; Worn Grips: single brown short fingerless wrist glove; Duelist Gloves: single dark rust leather wrist bracer; Flowing Wraps: single ivory crossing linen wrist binding.
ROW 4: Road Boots: single simple leather-strapped sandal; Windstep Boots: single indigo split-toe cloth shoe with gold ankle ties; Huntsman's Stride: single high tan leather shin sandal with pale fur cuff; Pilgrim's Pace: single soft tan wrap sandal with crossed cloth ankle straps; Ghostwalk: single midnight-blue tabi shoe with jade ties; Venom Grips: single dark jade scale-pattern wrist bracer; Hands of the Dawn: single golden ivory ornate sun wrist wrap; Temple Vest: sleeveless saffron ivory temple wrap vest with jade trim and patterned prayer stole.
